finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, "0 errors."

Two real bugs from the dependency bump, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries` (undefined), which threw on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Now treats `undefined` as `false` (disabled), matching old behavior.

The rest of the output (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267 deprecation notices, the tree-shaking/dedupe/progress lines) is just noisy log chatter from the bump — not warnings requiring code changes.
